name: UDT_PermGroup
description: Interlock group for PermLatch_AOI: group trip state, first-fault arbitration, operator reset (AL-1605-0840 sec. 7)

members.name: Trip_Sts
members.description: 1 = any permissive in the group is latched (group tripped), 0 = all clear

members.name: FF_Sts
members.description: 1 = a first fault has been assigned for the current trip event, 0 = none

members.name: Rst_Cmd
members.description: 1 = operator reset requested (EPICS/HMI sets, PLC clears), 0 = idle
